title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Honest Dashboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (Elbow console, sneaker stacks, and datamatics wait in the re-roll pool.)

options.label: The Honest Dashboard
options.lineage: automotive instrument clusters and dive computers
options.thesis: The tunnel as an honest machine: one ignition control, live gauges with real numbers, warning lamps that mean it.
options.viewport: A dark cockpit: ignition disc up top, status sentence, one gauge row (elapsed, scan %, egress), mode chips, and a five-tab bottom rail.
options.risk: Dashboard language can drift into clip-art gauges if the needles fake data; every meter must read a real value or stay absent.

raised.raise: Options surfaces group into hairline-ruled module grids, one small header tab per group — density without boxes-on-boxes.
System states print themselves as events in the log surface — state is content, not chrome.

regions.label: title strip — proxy chip · uptime · window controls
five-tab rail — Tunnel · Advanced · IP · History · Settings

options.label: The Shortwave Dial
options.lineage: shortwave receivers, the BBC Persian era
options.thesis: Scan the spectrum until a route locks: the needle, the signal bars, a dial you learn to trust.
options.viewport: A cream-faced tuning dial on dark metal: the disc becomes a dial with a frequency scale of routes, a needle that sweeps while scanning and locks when connected.
options.risk: Also the direction most signal-flavored redesigns reach for — familiar to the audience's grandparents, and where most maker hands stop.

options.label: The Descent Gauge
options.thesis: Connect as a descent: budget burned, stages crossed, daylight far above.
options.viewport: One vertical depth axis rules the window: Idle at the surface, Connecting crossing the thermocline, Connected cruising at depth with the scan budget as remaining gas.
options.case: Maps scan budget to gas budget almost perfectly; the audience never dives, so identification rests on the metaphor alone.
options.risk: Beautiful for the log surface; cold and foreign for a frightened first-time user.

options.label: The Ruled Module Wall
options.thesis: Every option as a boxed module under hairlines, packed edge to edge.
options.viewport: A mosaic of ruled modules with small red header tabs, dense as a Tokyo retail page.
options.case: Fuses well as an options-surface grammar, but tiny-type density fights the glance-over-shoulder user and the 14px readability floor.
options.kept: Hairline-ruled module discipline for the Advanced surface — already raised into the assigned card.
options.risk: Reads as a foreign site convention; density reads as stress.

options.label: The Printed Transcript
options.thesis: The whole app as one scrolling transcript; states print themselves.
options.viewport: One continuous scrolling log; controls are typed dialogue, not chrome.
options.case: Strong for the log surface, but the product's whole positioning is 'not the terminal' — this hands the frightened user a terminal back.
options.kept: States print themselves as events in the log — already raised into the assigned card.
options.risk: The one world this product was built to spare its users from.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every VPN app ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered power button, a country list, a settings drawer — the arrangement a visitor expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every commercial VPN by design.
